title: On the role of the tokenizer in ECG transformer models
abstract: arXiv:2609.15433v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tokenization determines both the physiological content presented to an ECG Transformer and the sequence over which attention operates. We compare eight tokenization strategies across Transformer, Informer, Reformer, and FEDformer on the nine-label CPSC2018 classification task. The input projection and principal backbone capacity are controlled to isolate the effect of token construction. Median-beat and HeartLang tokenization achieve mean macro-AUCs of 0.893 and 0.889 across the four backbones, compared with 0.822 and 0.824 for point-wise and patch-wise tokenization. Pooling the two physiology-aware representations yields an 8.2% relative improvement in macro-AUC. They also reduce mean sequence length from 1,250 to 158 tokens and mean peak training memory from 5.21 to 0.27 GB. translated_title: 关于分词器在心电图Transformer模型中的作用
translated_abstract: 分词化决定了呈现给心电图Transformer的生理内容以及注意力机制所作用的序列。我们在九标签CPSC2018分类任务上，比较了八种分词策略在Transformer、Informer、Reformer和FEDformer四种骨干网络上的表现。为了隔离分词构建的影响，我们对输入投影和主要骨干网络容量进行了控制。中位心跳和HeartLang分词在四个骨干网络上分别实现了0.893和0.889的平均宏AUC，而逐点和逐块分词分别仅为0.822和0.824。将两种生理感知表示进行池化可获得8.2%的宏AUC相对提升。它们还将平均序列长度从1,250个token减少到158个token，平均峰值训练内存从5.21 GB降至0.27 GB。结果表明，使token与心电图形态对齐可以在不增加骨干网络容量的情况下，同时提高预测性能和内存效率。
tldr: 该研究发现基于心电图形态学的分词策略（如中位心跳和HeartLang）能显著提升Transformer模型的分类性能并大幅降低训练内存消耗，且无需增加模型骨干容量。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that physiology-aware tokenization strategies (median-beat and HeartLang) significantly improve ECG Transformer classification performance and reduce training memory without increasing backbone capacity.
